audio.note: offset = timeline second at which audio time 0 plays. voiceover.mp3 is the owner's single ElevenLabs take, cut only inside its natural pauses and placed per cue by narration/place.py (no time-stretching). Cue start/end are the measured voiced times in the final file. The film is never stretched to fit the audio.

subtitles.note: Subtitles show each cue's text from start - lead to end + tail, never closer than minGap to the next cue, so they clear during pauses (including the Approve click at 40.9 s). Cue text is the exact spoken wording. Read by src/subtitles.ts and narration/srt.mjs.

voice.targetRate: about 4 to 4.5 syllables per second, never rushed
